Cat's Eye ESP browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Cat's Eye Hop Hed Fuzztone Published on September 18, 2005 Cat's Eye ESP fuzz pedal Controls Volume Tone Fuzz Information Cat's Eye ESP The Hop Hed Fuzztone is an all germanium fuzz made in the spirit of one of rock musics most recognized vintage effects… The MK III Tonebender. The Hop Hed Fuzztone faithfully reproduces Jimmy Page's Zeppelin era tone as well as many other classic fuzz sounds. Features include a gain trimmer for more dynamic control and a tone circuit with great treble response that's very useable throughout it's entire sweep. From Hard Rock to Jazz Fusion, the Hop Hed's Got It!
